leak_test_details: Script: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/83a4d5f8-8137-5cb1-9baa-8ac55fed2a66/scratchpad/ml/verify_components/leak.js, with outputs in leak_2022-23.out, leak_2023-24.out and leak_2024-25.out in the same folder. I tested rounds 5, 12, 20 and 33 of 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 (12 cases, 363 to 429 players each). For each case I built a truncated season file. History rows with round >= r are removed. Fixtures of round >= r are marked unfinished with no score. Every numeric column after the first 8 in the player rows is set to null, except 'code'. Events are reset so round r is the next event, and no later history or fixture results remain. For round r, only fixture info (opponent, home flag, fixture id) was kept outside the data, so the target set and club are known. I compared two paths against the full-data btRun predictions for round r. Path A is btRound on the truncated data. Path B is the production pmPredictAll on live-like truncated data, with totals rebuilt from the truncated history and the club set at round r. All 12 cases matched exactly (max abs diff 0.0 on both paths, including eMin and pp), with no missing or extra players. Positive control: leaky_control.js adds 1e-3 * end-of-season total_points to each prediction, and the same test flags it (diff 0.244 FAIL at 2023-24 r12 and r20). So the test does detect a leak.
other_leakage_or_protocol_issues: None found. The diff against fp_model.js is small and contains only the PMC block. It adds two shipped constants, LCK=1.05 (multiplies lc in core()) and GF0={2:0.84, 3:1.01, 4:0.95} (finishing shrink target), plus switches that are off by default: XG_GUARD, PW, KG/KA, AF0, GRM. None of the new code reads end-of-season totals, prices, xP, same-round rows or anything from 2025-26. It reads only player totals rebuilt by the replay, the history and finished fixtures. Re-running conv.js gives exactly GF0 = 0.84 / 1.01 / 0.95 (and AF0 = 1.19 / 1.35 / 2.16), pooled from TRAIN only (2022-23 GW16+ and 2023-24). There is no learned model. All 41 search configs in runs.jsonl and the 10 ablation runs in ablation.jsonl cover only 2022-23 and 2023-24. The LCK sweep (1.03 to 1.09) and the K_FIN/AF0 variants were run on TRAIN. 2024-25 appears only in final.js (one evaluation), which agrees with validation_looks=1. The experiment self-discloses that it printed per-round goal and xG sums for 2024-25 during a format check. I cannot verify this either way, and it cannot plausibly have tuned the two constants, both of which are traceable to TRAIN. Minor caveats that are not leakage: LCK and GF0 are hand-picked from TRAIN diagnostics, and the experiment itself notes they may not carry over to other seasons. I did not run reproduce.sh in place because it would overwrite files in exp_components. I recomputed the numbers independently with verify_components/mae.js.
